newsitem.title: USA: Flushing Financial sets new share buyback.
newsitem.headline: Flushing Financial sets new share buyback.

text.p: Flushing Financial Corp said Friday it would repurchase 409,688 of its shares, or about five percent of the stock outstanding, under a new buyback plan.
The shares to be repurchased are excluded from prior repurchase plans and are expected to be bought by November 21, 1997.
Under the bank's initial stock repurchase plan, Flushing Financial bought 431,250 shares, or five percent of the stock issued in its conversion from mutual to stock form.

Under its second repurchase plan, which ran concurrently with the initial program and continues today, the company is repurchasing 285,100 shares, which equals the number of shares it issued on May 21 as part of its 1996 Restricted Stock Incentive Plan, Flushing Financial said.
Some 79,500 shares remain to be repurchased under the second buyback program, it said.
Flushing Financial said it currently has 8,193,750 common shares outstanding.
